request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 2000 pcs of digital kitchen scale. The most we are willing to pay: USD 2.24 per pcs (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Valparaiso. Logo printing: yes. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Jinhai Household Products
Supplier message:
Hello dear,
Thanks for your inquiry about the digital kitchen scale.
Unit price 2.95 USD (FOB Shanghai).
Minimum order 500 pcs.
Production needs 35 days.
We accept 30% deposit, 70% T/T before loading.
Please confirm the quantity so we can prepare the PI.
Thanks and regards
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":2.95,"currency":"USD","moq":500,"moq_unit":"pcs","lead_time_days":35,"incoterm":"FOB","payment_terms":"30% deposit, 70% T/T before loading"}}

text:
{"reply": "Hello,

Thank you for your quote for the digital kitchen scale. Your price of USD 2.95 per pc is above what we can accept. We can proceed at USD 2.24 per pc, FOB Shanghai, for 2000 pcs, with logo printing and export cartons.

Please also confirm the following so we can finalize:
- Whether the price includes logo printing and export packaging
- Production lead time for an order of 2000 pcs
- Payment terms you accept for this order
- Any change to the minimum order quantity for this size of order
- Shipping terms and freight cost to Valparaiso, Chile, if you can quote it

If USD 2.24 per pc works for you, please send a revised quotation and we will proceed.

Best regards"}
